channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Minnesota women business leaders respond to big company CEOs
item.description: 95 women weigh in after top CEOs statement; First Avenue and local venues make a plea to music industry on the eve of Grammys. And Travis Kelce invests in Sleep Number.

item.title: Ice rink was a sanctuary for this girls hockey team until ICE touched down in the Twin Cities
item.description: Hockey Across Minnesota: A youth hockey club dedicated to diversity sees attendance dip amid federal agents’ presence.

item.title: A pair of teen Chicago brothers are in the thick of tracking, documenting ICE activity in Twin Cities
item.description: These teenagers have spent hours each day since Renee Good was killed patrolling the streets of Minneapolis to track federal agents carrying out immigration arrests.

item.title: AI image of Alex Pretti’s killing is the latest altered photo amid ICE surge in Minneapolis
item.description: Look closely, slow down, think critically before believing what you see on the internet, experts caution.

item.title: Roper: Why Minnesota became the epicenter of a national immigration crisis
item.description: The local resistance to a surge of federal agents reflects the state’s civically engaged culture.

item.title: Star Tribune analysis: Feds disobeying judicial orders on immigration detainees
item.description: The federal government cites a glut in cases and low staffing as reasons for violating court orders.

item.title: Minnesota has second-highest rate of violent injuries of hospital workers
item.description: High number of injuries among hospital workers in Minnesota includes intentional assaults and aggression by confused or delirious patients.

item.title: The latest: Alex Pretti involved in altercation with federal agents days before he was killed
item.description: Video shows Pretti being tackled by officers after he flipped his middle fingers at a vehicle carrying federal agents. An eyewitness said Pretti kicked out a taillight of the agents’ vehicle.

item.title: Mayor Jacob Frey to speak to U.S. mayors, lawmakers to urge end to ICE’s unlawful tactics
item.description: The Minneapolis mayor will meet with U.S. senators and mayors to push for an end to Operation Metro Surge.

item.title: U.S. Sen. Amy Klobuchar jumps into Minnesota governor’s race
item.description: Klobuchar’s entrance into the race shakes up a field that includes a dozen Republicans who want to make the 2026 election a referendum on the state’s fraud crisis.
